highlights.title: A calmer side panel
highlights.line: Where it runs, what it made and what it changed. One line each.

highlights.title: Drag an agent to split
highlights.line: Drop it on the middle line for half and half, or on the bottom to put it below.

highlights.title: Helpers on standby
highlights.line: Start helpers ahead of time. They wait for free and take the next task at once.

highlights.title: Pages open beside the chat
highlights.line: Keep talking while you look. Point at a part to ask for a change, or share a link.

highlights.title: Word files look like Word
highlights.line: Real pages, fonts and table borders, in light and dark.

highlights.title: Light, dimmed
highlights.line: A softer light theme for long days.

highlights.title: Summary view
highlights.line: New chats show answers and results. Steps are one click away.

highlights.title: Done today
highlights.line: The Inbox lists what finished today and what your team did.

highlights.title: Usage in one click
highlights.line: Click anywhere on the usage strip. The card opens in the same place every time.
